task_preferences.rationale: First better. Both correctly generate escaped PowerShell 7 commands, but the first provides clearer visual separation between the purpose and commands and keeps the literal-escaping logic as a focused helper.
Second better. Both correctly remove the shared request state, but the second more directly verifies the reported reproduction in addition to the full visible suite.

First better. Both protect differing destinations and create recoverable backups, but the first additionally rejects identical or nested source and destination paths, preventing unsafe recursive synchronization.
